findings.title: AssignmentSource.queued default is evaluated once at import time
findings.body: The dataclass default is written as `queued: datetime = timezone.now()`, so `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the module is imported. Every `AssignmentSource` created without an explicit `queued` value, including via `from_dict` when `queued` is missing, will carry that same stale timestamp instead of the time the assignment change was queued. Any logging, metrics, debugging, or future time-based logic using `queued` will be incorrect. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` instead.

findings.title: from_dict silently discards invalid or unknown serialized payloads
findings.body: `AssignmentSource.from_dict` constructs the dataclass with `cls(**input_dict)` and returns `None` on `TypeError`/`ValueError`. Any unexpected extra key in the serialized payload causes the entire assignment source to be dropped, and the dataclass constructor does not validate or coerce types; for example, `integration_id` may remain a string and `queued` is not parsed back into a datetime after JSON round-trips. In `sync_assignee_outbound`, a dropped or invalid source is treated as no source, which can allow an outbound sync back to the integration that originated the change and defeat the cycle prevention. Validate required fields, coerce types, and tolerate unknown fields or log failures instead of silently returning `None`.

findings.title: No test that deassign with a matching AssignmentSource suppresses outbound sync
findings.body: The PR adds cycle prevention to both `GroupAssignee.objects.assign` and `GroupAssignee.objects.deassign`, but the new matching-source test only covers assignment. The existing unassign test calls `GroupAssignee.objects.deassign(self.group)` without an assignment source and asserts outbound sync happens; there is no test that deassigning with `AssignmentSource.from_integration(integration)` does not call `sync_assignee_outbound` for the same integration. A regression in the deassign path could reintroduce sync loops without being caught.
